answer: A live sounding cannot be pre-logged: lamp codes appear only after the tide turns. The claimant escrows 8.65 POA for a 22-byte mooring chit (epoch seed folded into a 36-bit pile ticket posted 21 minutes prior). They winch a tagged 18 kg anchor along the east jetty, then shoot three sextant cuts 88 seconds apart on a posted horizon lamp, each cut hashed to the chit by two unaligned dockmasters. Reviewers rebuild those hashes and discard any second chit for that pile. Price: 8.65 POA plus the live haul. A reused chit, pre-logged cut, or lamp miss slashes 68% and darkens the pile four epochs.
